description: Source code for exporting boards and related data into a ZIP archive in the focalboard server application.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application struct with methods for exporting boards and related data.

methods.name: ExportArchive
methods.description: Exports specified boards and their data into a ZIP archive.

methods.name: writeArchiveVersion
methods.description: Writes the archive version and timestamp to the ZIP.

methods.name: writeArchiveBoard
methods.description: Writes a single board and its related data to the archive.

methods.name: writeArchiveBoardMemberLine
methods.description: Writes a board member entry to the archive.

methods.name: writeArchiveBlockLine
methods.description: Writes a block entry to the archive.

methods.name: writeArchiveBoardLine
methods.description: Writes a board entry to the archive.

methods.name: writeArchiveFile
methods.description: Writes a file associated with a board to the archive.

methods.name: getBoardsForArchive
methods.description: Fetches board data for given board IDs.
